agency.name: Office of Addiction Services and Supports (OASAS)

countyDirectory.name: OASAS Provider and Program Search / Treatment Availability Dashboard (Find Addiction Treatment)

narrAffiliate.name: New York State Alliance of Recovery Residences (NYSARR)

narrNote: NYSARR appears on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched 2026-10-22); NARR's own affiliate profile describes NYSARR as New York's 'emerging' affiliate. NYSARR's site was fetched and content-checked this run.
notes: OASAS is New York's Single State Agency for substance use services (per SAMHSA's SSA directory, confirmed via NASADAD's SSA listing and on oasas.ny.gov). The agency phone listed is the 24/7 HOPEline, which OASAS publishes as its contact line across its official pages; the HOPEline also accepts texts (text HOPENY to 467369). The countyDirectory entry is OASAS's official treatment locator, searchable by county, city, and ZIP. Medicaid: New York Medicaid covers substance use disorder treatment delivered by OASAS-certified programs, largely through Medicaid managed care, but no single official consumer-facing Medicaid SUD page could be fetch-verified in this run (repeated searches surfaced only commercial rehab sites), so medicaidSud is null rather than guessed. Every URL in this file was fetched and content-checked on 2026-10-22.
